prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1375; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, email, or in writing. Our client has retained counsel and any communications from your company or its representatives should come through us.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any applicable umbrella or excess coverage. Please also confirm whether a claim has been opened and provide the claim number assigned.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, and all correspondence with any party. Please suspend any routine deletion or overwriting of such materials. Failure to preserve this evidence may result in sanctions in any subsequent litigation.
